diagnostic_markers.triage: Windows RAW_PAYLOAD_TX without Linux MUX_RAW_PAYLOAD_RX points at physical/NAT/ISP transit. Linux MUX_RAW_PAYLOAD_RX without server PEEK points at mux association/relay. PEEK without ACCEPT_PASS points at wolfSSL handshake. Server ACCEPT_PASS without Windows RAW_PAYLOAD_RX points at return raw/Npcap capture. Windows RAW_PAYLOAD_RX without CONNECT_PASS points at wolfSSL client processing.
